title: NSE Trading Holidays (2000-2026)
description: Reconciled NSE/BSE trading-holiday calendar. Dates are taken from the Zipline/quantopian XBOM trading calendar and cross-checked against transcriptions of official NSE circulars (marketholidays.in) for 2023-2026, the kartikkasat/nse-calendar-data dataset, the vacanza/holidays NSE calendar, and jugaad-py/master-data.
reconciliation: Every date was validated against observed index sessions: a date with a genuine full-day session was removed from the holiday set; a date with only a Muhurat one-hour session remains a holiday and is flagged has_special_session=true; zero-volume carry-forward rows are treated as artifacts and the date stays a holiday.
notes: Muhurat-trading dates (e.g. 2022-10-24, 2024-11-01, 2025-10-21) are official NSE holidays that hosted a one-hour special session. They are flagged has_special_session and are excluded from the index master.
NSE revoked the 2013-11-14 Muharram holiday by circular: 2013-11-14 was a trading day and 2013-11-15 is the holiday.
The 2023 Bakri Id holiday was moved from 28-Jun to 29-Jun-2023 (NSE/CMTR/57285); 28-Jun-2023 was a trading day.
Dates in `missing_sessions` are genuine trading days for which no index published a bar; the pipeline logs a warning and leaves them out rather than inventing prices.
